articles.title: Top & Bottom Bond Funds 2Q26: Bond Markets Rebound, but Rate Risks Remain
articles.claim_summary: Bond funds staged a broad rebound in 2Q26 as pressures from an earlier energy shock subsided, though persistent interest rate risks make short-to-medium duration bonds and investment-grade credit the optimal allocation strategy.

findings.title: U.S. Energy Secretary Wright says Iran nuclear deal may never happen - CNBC
findings.reason: The article states that the U.S.-Iran war has 'sent energy prices soaring worldwide' and Energy Secretary Chris Wright noted that an elusive nuclear deal 'may never happen,' directly undercutting the claim that pressures from an earlier energy shock have subsided.
